description: Acceptance-test feature backlog for the PomodoroFlow Pomodoro productivity PWA, derived from the UI draft at docs/pomodoro-draft.png. Agents implement features incrementally and only set passes=true after verifying every step.
instructions: Treat each feature as an independently verifiable requirement.
Implement features in phase/dependency order and keep changes focused.
Do not set passes=true unless every listed step has been verified against the implementation.
If a step cannot be verified, leave passes=false and document the blocker outside this file.
Keep the MVP frontend-only; do not add a backend or authentication unless the project scope is explicitly changed.
Match the draft's visual language (glass surfaces, coral accent, full-bleed wallpaper) through shared tokens, never per-component hex values.
Use deterministic tests for timer logic; avoid relying on long real-time waits in automated tests.
This is a Next.js 16 App Router project: keep app/page.tsx a Server Component shell and isolate 'use client' to interactive leaves (timer, panels, audio, theme toggle).
Never commit generated service worker artifacts (public/sw.js, public/swe-worker-*.js).

layout.desktop: Full-bleed ambient wallpaper; product title top-left; header icon trio top-right (theme, settings, tasks); centered Focus/Short Break/Long Break tabs; glass icon rail on the left (timer, streak, focus insights, settings, tasks); centered ring with 25:00 and 'Focus session' pill; primary Start pill; Music pill bottom-left; Tasks + Settings pills bottom-right.
layout.mobile: Title + header icon trio; stacked mode tabs; centered ring and Start; bottom navigation with Music / Tasks / Settings.
layout.surfaces: Rounded-full pills, blurred dark glass, 1px white/12 borders, soft coral glow around the active ring.

assetsRequired: Icon set for rail/header/bottom navigation (timer, flame, brain, gear, checklist, sun, music, play/pause)
openQuestions: The draft shows no session-history or statistics screen: those must live in a Focus insights view or a tab inside the Tasks sheet (F010/F011/F026).
The music source and licenses are undefined; offline caching of long audio files affects PWA cache strategy (F023/F033).
Light mode is not mocked in the draft; F024/F016 must define the light token set explicitly.
The IndexedDB schema only has a 'todos' store today; sessions, settings and streaks need a version bump with an in-place upgrade (no migrations system).
The draft font is not specified; the current layout uses Geist, which is acceptable if tabular numerals are enabled for the countdown.

technicalNotes: Design tokens belong in app/globals.css using Tailwind v4 @theme; there is no tailwind.config.*.
The service worker (app/sw.ts) is bundled by Webpack; production build only. Dev runs Turbopack with Serwist disabled.
app/lib/db.ts currently exposes only a todos store keyed by id with a by-synced index; bump the DB version and edit upgrade() in place to add sessions/settings/tasks.
app/lib/sync.ts is a stub that registers a window listener at module scope; import it only from client components until real sync exists.
deleteTodo hard-deletes with no tombstone, so deletions cannot be synced; do not build sync cleanup on top of it.
There are no tests, no CI, and no test script yet; F014 must add the runner and wire it before validating other features.

features.designRef: desktop: full shell; mobile: header, tabs, ring, Start, bottom nav
features.description: The application loads into the PomodoroFlow shell shown in the draft: full-bleed ambient background, product title, mode tabs, centered timer stage and quick-access navigation, responsive from 320px to 1920px.
steps: Load `/` at 1440x900 and verify the background, title, mode tabs, timer stage and navigation render without console errors or hydration warnings.
Load `/` at 390x844 and verify the timer, Start action and bottom navigation are fully visible without horizontal scrolling.
Verify the timer and tasks surfaces are reachable from the mobile bottom navigation and all five destinations (timer, streak, focus insights, settings, tasks) from the desktop rail.
Verify `app/page.tsx` stays a Server Component and `'use client'` is limited to interactive leaves (timer, panels, audio, theme toggle).
Hard-refresh with cache disabled and verify the application still boots.

features.designRef: Start pill and 25:00 ring
features.description: A user can start, pause, resume and reset a focus timer with the primary Start/Resume control in the timer stage.
steps: Set a short focus duration for testing.
Press Start and verify the displayed remaining time decreases and the control switches to Pause.
Pause the timer and verify the remaining time stops decreasing.
Resume the timer and verify the countdown continues from the paused value.
Reset the timer and verify it returns to the configured focus duration and the control returns to Start.
Verify rapid Start/Pause clicks cannot create two concurrent countdowns.

features.designRef: settings sheet opened from the gear icon (header, rail, bottom nav)
features.description: A user can configure focus, short-break and long-break durations within valid limits, with validation that rejects invalid input.
steps: Open timer settings from the header or rail gear icon.
Set valid focus, short-break and long-break durations and save.
Verify the timer uses the selected duration for each mode after switching modes.
Enter an invalid duration such as zero, a negative value, a value above the allowed maximum, or non-numeric input.
Verify invalid values are rejected with an inline, non-color-only message and the existing valid settings remain intact.
Verify settings survive a page reload (F012).

features.designRef: Focus / Short Break / Long Break tabs with dot indicators and underline
features.description: The timer supports focus, short-break and long-break modes with the tab control and mode indicators from the draft.
steps: Select Focus and verify the focus duration and 'Focus session' pill label are displayed.
Switch to Short Break and verify its duration, dot indicator and label.
Switch to Long Break and verify its duration, dot indicator and label.
Verify the active mode is distinguishable without relying on color alone (underline plus dot fill plus `aria-selected`).
Verify switching modes while running follows a documented rule (either blocked with feedback or reset with confirmation) and never mixes durations.

features.designRef: ring reaching zero, 'Focus session' pill, Start pill reset
features.description: When a session completes, the application handles completion exactly once and provides clear, multi-sensory feedback.
steps: Set a duration short enough to complete during testing.
Start the timer and allow it to finish.
Verify completion feedback is shown (visual copy, live-region announcement, and sound per F028).
Verify the timer stops at 00:00 and never shows or stores negative time.
Verify exactly one completion event and one session record are created, including under React StrictMode double effects.
Verify a reset or abandoned timer is not recorded as completed.
Verify the next mode suggestion (break after focus) matches the draft's flow and is announced.

features.designRef: Tasks pill (desktop bottom-right) / Tasks bottom-nav item
features.description: A user can create a task with a title and optional description, priority and status from the Tasks sheet.
steps: Open the Tasks sheet and create a task with a valid title and no optional fields.
Verify the task appears in the task list immediately.
Create a task with a description and priority and verify all supplied details are displayed.
Attempt to create a task with an empty or whitespace-only title and verify validation prevents it with an inline message.
Verify the sheet's form is keyboard submittable and labelled (F013).

features.designRef: task list rows inside the Tasks sheet
features.description: A user can edit and delete existing tasks with appropriate confirmation or feedback.
steps: Create a task.
Edit its title and priority and save.
Verify the updated values appear in the list and persist after reload.
Delete the task and verify a confirmation or undo affordance is shown for destructive actions.
Verify the task no longer appears in the list after deletion.
Verify cancelling an edit leaves the original task unchanged.

features.description: A user can change a task status and filter tasks by status and priority.
steps: Create tasks with different statuses and priorities.
Change one task's status from the list.
Verify the new status is shown and persisted.
Filter by status and verify only matching tasks are displayed.
Filter by priority and verify only matching tasks are displayed.
Clear filters and verify the full task list returns.
Verify the empty-filtered state explains how to clear filters.

features.designRef: active task context near the timer stage
features.description: A user can associate a focus session with a selected task.
steps: Create at least two tasks.
Select one task as the active task for a focus session.
Show the active task next to the timer stage and verify it is announced to assistive tech.
Start and complete a focus session.
Verify the completed session references the selected task.
Verify changing the selected task later does not rewrite previously completed sessions.

features.description: Completed focus sessions are recorded with duration, completion time and optional associated task, and are viewable in a history surface.
steps: Complete a focus session.
Open the session history from the Focus insights view.
Verify the session appears with the correct duration and completion time in local time.
Verify the associated task is shown when one was selected.
Verify an abandoned or reset timer is not counted as a completed session.
Verify history persists across reloads.
Verify history renders correctly for an empty store.

features.designRef: Focus insights destination on the rail (brain icon)
features.description: The dashboard and Focus insights view display daily focus statistics derived from recorded sessions.
steps: Complete multiple focus sessions.
Verify the daily completed-session count matches the history.
Verify total focus time equals the sum of qualifying completed sessions for the selected day.
Verify statistics update after another session completes without a manual reload.
Verify the empty state explains what to do, not just `0`.
Verify totals use the browser's local timezone day boundaries.

features.description: Tasks, timer settings, streaks and session history persist across a page refresh using IndexedDB, with recovery from malformed or unavailable storage.
steps: Create a task, change timer settings, select a track (F023) and complete a focus session.
Refresh the page and verify tasks, settings, selected track and session history are restored.
Verify the IndexedDB schema bump uses an in-place `upgrade()` with the new stores and no data loss for existing todos.
Simulate malformed stored values and verify the app boots with recoverable defaults and no crash.
Simulate IndexedDB being unavailable (private mode/quota) and verify a visible fallback state.
Verify an in-progress timer is restored from its stored target time (F027).

features.description: Core timer, task and navigation workflows can be operated with a keyboard, have accessible labels, and remain legible on the glass/dark surfaces.
steps: Navigate the primary controls using only the keyboard and verify the tab order follows the visual order.
Verify interactive controls have visible focus indicators with sufficient contrast on glass and wallpaper backgrounds.
Verify form fields have associated labels or accessible names.
Verify icon-only buttons (rail, header, player, bottom nav) expose accessible names and tooltips.
Verify the timer ring exposes progress semantics and completion is announced via a live region.
Verify validation and completion feedback are understandable without relying on color alone.
Verify the decorative wallpaper is not announced (empty alt / aria-hidden) and images keep `alt` text where informative.

features.description: Core timer, task, persistence and statistics logic is covered by automated tests wired to an npm script.
steps: Add a test runner and verify `npm test` executes the suite (there is no test setup today).
Verify timer transitions and duration-validation tests pass using a mocked clock.
Verify task validation and task-update tests pass.
Verify session aggregation and daily-statistics tests pass.
Verify persistence parsing/recovery tests pass, including malformed and unavailable storage.
Verify `npx eslint app` and `npm run build` still pass after the test setup is added.

features.description: The repository README explains the product, setup, scripts, architecture, design system and test workflow.
steps: Replace the create-next-app boilerplate README and verify it describes the problem and MVP functionality.
Verify setup instructions work from a clean checkout (`npm install`, `npm run dev`).
Verify development, build, start, lint and test commands are documented accurately, including the lint-before-build gotcha and generated `public/sw.js` artifacts.
Verify the App Router/Server-Client component architecture and the IndexedDB persistence approach are briefly explained.
Verify the design tokens, wallpaper/audio assets and draft reference (docs/pomodoro-draft.png) are documented.

features.designRef: whole draft: coral accent, dark glass, pill geometry
features.description: The draft's visual language is codified as Tailwind v4 theme tokens in app/globals.css and consumed by every component.
steps: Verify `app/globals.css` declares the draft palette (accent #FD8464, text #FFFFFF, muted #BEBFD3, overlay #0D121B) through `@theme` tokens.
Verify glass surfaces (rail, pills, sheets, player) share one backdrop-blur/border/radius token set instead of ad-hoc classes.
Verify components use token utilities and no component hardcodes a hex color.
Verify accent, muted and border tokens keep WCAG AA contrast on both wallpaper and glass surfaces.
Verify the light variant of every token is defined, not only the dark one.
Verify dark mode remains the default and `prefers-color-scheme` is respected until the user overrides it.

features.designRef: full-bleed sunset wallpaper with seated character and pond
features.description: The ambient wallpaper fills the viewport behind the app shell, stays legible under UI text, and works offline.
steps: Verify the wallpaper renders edge-to-edge at desktop and mobile with no tiling, letterboxing or scrollbars.
Verify the composition keeps the character and sun visible at 390px via an art-directed crop or object-position.
Verify text-bearing areas have a scrim/gradient strong enough for AA contrast at both viewports.
Verify the wallpaper is served through `next/image` with priority, explicit dimensions and responsive sizes.
Verify the asset is cached by the service worker for offline rendering (F033).
Verify a CSS-only gradient fallback renders if the image fails to load.
Verify the wallpaper does not cause layout shift or block first paint of the timer stage.

features.designRef: large coral progress ring with head dot and 25:00 numerals
features.description: The countdown is presented as a radial progress ring that matches the draft and exposes accessible progress semantics.
steps: Verify the ring stroke represents the remaining fraction of the session.
Verify the arc angle matches remaining time at 25%, 50% and 90% completion.
Verify the head dot sits on the leading edge of the arc and advances smoothly.
Verify numerals are tabular and the 25:00 area does not shift layout each second.
Verify the timer is exposed as a progressbar (or equivalent) with min/max/now values and a readable label.
Verify ring motion and glow respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

features.designRef: centered Focus / Short Break / Long Break tabs with dots and underline
features.description: Mode switching uses an accessible tab control with the dot indicators and active underline from the draft.
steps: Verify Focus, Short Break and Long Break render with dot indicators and an active underline.
Verify the active tab is conveyed through `aria-selected`, underline and dot fill, not color alone.
Verify switching tabs updates the duration, ring and session pill label immediately.
Verify ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End move focus inside a `tablist` and Enter/Space activates.
Verify the tab control does not overflow at 320px or at 200% zoom.

features.designRef: left vertical glass rail: timer, flame, brain, gear, tasks
features.description: Desktop navigation is a left glass rail with accessible icon buttons for timer, streak, focus insights, settings and tasks.
steps: Verify the rail renders as a vertical glass pill with the five draft destinations.
Verify each icon-only button has an accessible name and a visible tooltip on hover and focus.
Verify the active destination is visually distinct without relying on color alone.
Verify the rail stays clear of the timer stage and keeps it centered at 1024px, 1280px and 1440px.
Verify the rail is hidden below the breakpoint where the mobile bottom navigation takes over.
Verify the rail order matches the draft and the tab order is logical.

features.designRef: mobile bottom bar: Music / Tasks / Settings
features.description: Mobile navigation is the bottom bar from the draft, usable with iOS safe areas and without covering the primary action.
steps: Verify mobile renders the bottom bar with Music, Tasks and Settings and no desktop rail.
Verify the bar clears the Start action and respects `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.
Verify the active item is distinguishable without color alone and is announced to assistive tech.
Verify tapping an item opens its panel without losing timer state.
Verify the bar stays reachable in landscape and at 320px width.

features.designRef: Tasks and Settings pills / header icon trio
features.description: Tasks and Settings open as accessible sheets (right-side on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile) instead of separate pages.
steps: Verify Settings opens as a right-side sheet on desktop and a bottom sheet on mobile.
Verify Escape closes the sheet and focus returns to the element that opened it.
Verify focus is trapped inside the open sheet and background scroll is locked.
Verify the open sheet is labelled, has a visible close control and is announced as a dialog.
Verify a running timer keeps counting while a sheet is open and remains visible or clearly indicated.
Verify closing a sheet does not discard saved changes or reset the timer.

features.designRef: Music pill bottom-left and Music item in mobile bottom bar
features.description: A user can play ambient music during sessions from the Music player without it interfering with the timer.
steps: Verify the Music pill opens a player with play/pause, previous/next, a track list and volume.
Verify audio never autoplays and starts only on an explicit Play press.
Verify selected track and volume persist across reloads (F012).
Verify playback continues while navigating between panels and while the timer runs.
Verify a mute toggle is available for focus and break sessions.
Verify tracks play offline after the first load and show a clear error when unavailable.
Verify the player is keyboard operable and exposes state with `aria-pressed`.

features.designRef: sun icon in the header icon trio
features.description: A theme toggle switches between the dark draft theme and a legible light theme, with no flash of the wrong theme.
steps: Verify the sun control toggles light/dark and the choice persists across reloads.
Verify first paint matches the stored or system theme with no visible flash.
Verify the default follows system preference and tracks OS changes until the user overrides it.
Verify accent, glass and text tokens keep AA contrast in light mode.
Verify the wallpaper treatment stays legible in light mode (scrim or alternate asset).

features.designRef: flame icon in the desktop rail
features.description: A streak view reports consecutive focus days derived from completed sessions.
steps: Verify the flame destination reports the current consecutive-day streak from completed focus sessions.
Verify day boundaries use the browser's local timezone rather than UTC.
Verify two sessions on the same day count as one streak day.
Verify a skipped day resets the current streak to zero while the best streak is preserved.
Verify the empty state explains what a streak is and how to start one.
Verify the streak is recomputed from session history, not a separately mutable counter.

features.designRef: brain icon in the desktop rail
features.description: The Focus insights view summarizes focus minutes per day and week from recorded sessions.
steps: Verify the brain destination summarizes focus minutes per day for the current week.
Verify totals match the sum of completed focus sessions for the same range.
Verify the today/week range selector is reflected in labels and values.
Verify the view updates after a session completes without a reload.
Verify empty and single-session states render meaningful copy.
Verify the summary is readable with a screen reader (table or list semantics, not color-only chart).

features.description: The countdown is timestamp-based and stays accurate across background tabs, system sleep and reloads.
steps: Verify remaining time is derived from a target timestamp rather than interval decrements.
Verify a 10-minute session is still accurate after the tab is backgrounded for 2 minutes.
Verify system sleep/resume does not produce negative time or double completion.
Verify `document.title` reflects remaining time while running and resets when stopped.
Verify an in-progress session is restored after a reload from its stored target time.
Verify a deterministic unit test advances a mocked clock through start, pause, resume and completion.

features.description: Session completion produces a single chime and, when permitted, a single browser notification.
steps: Verify a completion chime plays exactly once when the timer ends.
Verify the chime respects a mute toggle and never plays on pause or reset.
Verify Web Notification permission is requested only after an explicit user action.
Verify at most one notification is shown per completion, including after re-renders or reloads.
Verify completion is also announced in a live region for users who cannot hear the chime.
Verify the app degrades silently when notification permission is denied.

features.description: Keyboard shortcuts accelerate timer and panel control without interfering with text entry.
steps: Verify Space toggles start/pause when focus is not in an input, textarea or contenteditable.
Verify R resets the timer and 1/2/3 switch modes.
Verify documented keys open Tasks and Settings and Escape closes them.
Verify shortcuts do not fire while typing a task title or description.
Verify a help affordance lists the available shortcuts.
Verify shortcuts are discoverable to assistive tech and do not trap the user.

features.description: The screen stays awake during a running focus session via the Screen Wake Lock API where supported.
steps: Verify the screen wake lock is requested while a focus session runs (Chromium).
Verify the lock is released on pause, reset, completion, tab hide and unmount.
Verify the lock is re-acquired when the tab becomes visible and the timer is still running.
Verify unsupported browsers degrade without console errors or broken UI.

features.description: The app is installable as a standalone PWA with correct manifest metadata, icons and theme color.
steps: Verify `app/manifest.ts` exposes name, short_name, description, theme_color (#FD8464), background_color, display standalone and start_url.
Verify 192x192 and 512x512 PNG icons plus a maskable icon exist in public/icons and are referenced without 404s.
Verify apple-touch-icon and theme-color meta are present for iOS installation.
Verify Lighthouse installability checks pass on a production build.
Verify the installed app launches standalone and offline after one visit.
Verify the service worker is only active in production (`npm run build && npm start`).

features.description: Motion in the shell, tabs, ring and sheets is consistent, performant and respects reduced-motion preferences.
steps: Verify tab switches, sheet open/close and navigation use one shared duration/easing token.
Verify all animations are disabled or reduced under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
Verify no animation causes layout shift on the timer stage (CLS near zero).
Verify the countdown and glow animation stay smooth without long frames.
Verify motion does not delay interaction or block the Start action.

features.description: The PWA works offline for the shell, data and previously loaded assets, and surfaces update/offline states.
steps: Verify the app shell loads with the network offline after one production visit.
Verify the wallpaper renders offline and audio falls back gracefully when uncached.
Verify IndexedDB tasks, settings and sessions are readable offline and local writes succeed.
Verify an offline indicator appears without blocking the timer.
Verify a new service worker version prompts a reload instead of refreshing aggressively.
Verify stale cached HTML never serves a version that breaks the IndexedDB schema.

features.description: The layout holds up across the draft's desktop and mobile compositions, touch targets and zoom levels.
steps: Verify layouts at 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, 1280x800 and 1440x900 with no overlap or horizontal scroll.
Verify all interactive targets are at least 44x44 CSS px on touch.
Verify the timer remains the dominant element at every breakpoint.
Verify the layout is usable at 200% browser zoom and 320px width.
Verify the mode tabs and bottom navigation never clip or overlap the timer stage.
Verify mobile landscape does not hide the Start action behind the bottom bar.
